Priya M: Quick idea - propose a compact 72h follow-up template + incident commander rotation rules. React with :eyes: to iterate.
Sam O: SGTM. can you sketch the template?
Priya M: Sure, draft below. Goal: actionable owners, dates, short blocker notes. Use at retro and 72h check-in.
Priya M: "72h-checkin-template:
- Incident ID: <INC-XXXX>
- 1-line summary
- Severity & impact
- Owner(s): IC / Remediation owner / QA owner
- 24h actions (owner, due)
- 72h status (done/in-progress/blocked), blockers, next step
- Follow-ups: ticket refs + due dates
- Recurrence flag: yes/no + notes"
Kai L: Love it. Add "rollback risk" and "customer impact note" to help prioritize.
Jess F: Also recommend rotation rules: IC = oncall primary for 8h, backup = platform volunteer; if incident >6h, prepare 12h handoffs and explicit handoff notes in thread.
Sam O: Can we add auto-reminders? IncidentBot ping remediation owners at 24h & 72h with the template.
IncidentBot: scheduled reminder queued -> will ping @RemediationOwner at 2951234800 (simulated)
Priya M: I'll land a lightweight doc and run a 2-week pilot starting Monday. Volunteers for the rotation?
Kai L: I'll take week 1.
Jess F: I'll take week 2.
Sam O: I'll implement the IncidentBot reminders and add a tiny metric for "follow-up lag". Also propose a 4-cycle pilot retro to check recurrence reduction.
Priya M: Sounds good. Retro agenda: what saved time, what added overhead, blind spots. If no objections I'll post to #eng-playbooks and cc SRE leads.
Sam O: :thumbsup:
Jess F: :raised_hands:
